verdict.rationale: The axis applies: AIMA is a government immigration agency with an online filing flow, and publishing its operating hours, daily limits or session timeouts up front is a fair question. The only evidence is a failed TLS probe of robots.txt, with nothing fetched from the host. It says nothing about whether such constraints are disclosed before a user starts.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
